evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing (date, name, address) without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer in response to a genuine agenda question.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave time ranges ('7 to 8 hours') and specific dollar anchors for both scenarios: packing service $3,257–$3,864 for two-day move, or $1,632 for move-only. Personalized to the customer's stated interest in two quotes and their townhome size.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never explicitly asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Customer self-directed: 'Are you able to send both those quotes over via email to me?' and later 'if I do decide to go forward with you all, I will give you back a call.' Rep accepted this without closing the sale.

top_strength: Chauntelle gathered all discovery basics cleanly (name, date, both addresses, square footage, room count, property type) and delivered two detailed, anchor-specific estimates with transparent hourly pricing and no hidden fees.
coaching_note: Section 2 — you skipped 'Their Agenda' entirely and jumped straight into probing; this cost you the chance to uncover what actually matters most to Carlos beyond price, and Section 7 — you never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' explicitly, letting the customer walk away with only a promise to call back, when a direct ask could have booked the service on this call.
